title: MONUMENT: BENEFICIAL PLAZA AND LIBERTY PARK, HISTORIC-CULTURAL MONUMENT
text:
MONUMENT: BENEFICIAL PLAZA AND LIBERTY PARK, HISTORIC-CULTURAL MONUMENT
  #1157

  Plan Area: Wilshire  Council District: 10 – Hutt

  PROPERTY ADDRESS:  3700 – 3732 Wilshire Boulevard; 651 – 673 South Serrano Avenue;
  658 – 674 South Oxford Avenue

  Informational presentation on the proposed rehabilitation of the Monument from office to residential.
  Commission review and comment.

  Owner/Applicant:  Wilshire Park Place LLC

  Presenters:  John LoCascio, Historic Resources Group; Rocky Rockefeller, Rockefeller
  Partners

  6.  MONUMENT: MAY COMPANY GARAGE, HISTORIC-CULTURAL MONUMENT #1001

  Plan Area: Downtown  Council District: 14 – Jurado

  PROPERTY ADDRESS:  900 – 914 South Hill Street; 216 – 224 West 9th Street

  Informational presentation on the proposed rehabilitation project for reuse of the building for self-service
  storage. Commission review and comment.

  Owner/Applicant:  900 S Hill LLC

  Presenters:  Darren Mehdizadeh, Markwood Enterprises; Taek Kim, Ware Malcomb; and
  Robert Chattel, Heritage Consulting Group
summary: Informational presentation and commission review of proposed rehabilitation of Beneficial Plaza and Liberty Park Historic-Cultural Monument from office to residential use.

details.action: Commission review of proposed rehabilitation from office to residential
